## 🐛 Fixed

- **Security updates for the branding app's build.** The tools that build the branding web extension pick up fixed releases of DOMPurify, axios, follow-redirects, ws, re2js, qs, minimatch, glob, adm-zip, source-map-js and zod, which clears their published advisories. The extension that ends up in the image is byte for byte the same. One low-severity advisory in deepmerge stays open because no fixed release exists yet.
